elements.name: getAggregatedBluetoothFilters
elements.docstring:
Get aggregated Bluetooth filters from all loaded plugins

Collects, validates, deduplicates, prioritizes, and limits Bluetooth discovery filters
from all plugins that implement getBluetoothFilters().

Process:
1. Iterate through all loaded plugins
2. Call getBluetoothFilters() if method exists
3. Validate each filter using Zod schema
4. Track source plugin for each filter
5. Deduplicate by service UUID
6. Sort by priority (descending: 10 -> 1)
7. Limit to 80 filters max
8. Log warnings for dropped filters

@returns AggregatedBluetoothFilters with filters array and metadata

Bluetooth Low Energy Transport Implementation

Provides BLE connectivity for TrainingBridge physical devices using the
@abandonware/noble library. Implements retry logic, connection management,
and GATT operations (read, write, subscribe).

Features:
- Device discovery with TrainingBridge service UUID filtering
- Automatic reconnection with exponential backoff
- Concurrent connection management (up to 10 devices)
- GATT characteristic operations (read, write, notify)
- EventBus integration for device lifecycle events
- Health monitoring with periodic connection checks

NOTE: Requires Visual Studio build tools on Windows for noble native compilation.
See docs/architecture/bluetooth-setup.md for platform-specific setup instructions.
